note: Synthetic items with known receipt-level outcomes; extend only by adding.

items.diff:
Function sums prices with integer division, dropping cents.
-    total += price
+    total += price // 100
items.spec: Spec: totals must be exact to the cent.
items.finding: BLOCK. The diff divides prices by 100 using integer division, so any price below 100 contributes 0 and totals lose cents. This contradicts the spec and corrupts every invoice.

items.diff:
Handler reads the token from the query string and compares with ==.
+    if request.args['token'] == SECRET:
items.spec: Spec: admin endpoints must require the secret token; compare in constant time.
items.finding: BLOCK. The secret is compared with ==, which leaks timing, and is read from the query string, which is logged. The spec asks for a constant-time comparison.

items.diff:
Retry loop never sleeps and has no cap.
+    while not ok:
+        ok = call()
items.spec: Spec: retry at most 5 times with backoff.
items.finding: BLOCK. The loop retries forever with no delay, against a spec of five retries with backoff. A failing dependency will be hammered and the process will hang.

items.spec: Spec: release automation. Repository rule: any release or publish script change is merged only by the owner.
items.finding: BLOCK. This PR changes a publish step. Under the repository rule, publish scripts are owner-reserved, so it cannot be merged by the review process whatever its quality. The code itself reads fine.
